correctness.rationale: Contracting k compatible prescribed arrows in Ewens permutations gives theta^c/(theta+n-k)_k probabilities; summing descending ordered image pairs yields p_n=(n-1)(n+2theta-2)/[2(n+theta-1)(n+theta-2)]. Conditioning on F_i=1 deletes the fixed letter and reduces to Ewens on n-1 labels. For remote positions conditional descent has probability p_(n-1); at incidence the probabilities are (i-1)/(theta+n-2) and (n-i)/(theta+n-2). Multiplying by q_n=theta/(theta+n-1) and subtracting q_n p_n gives all entries and the stated remote factor. Summing over all i,j yields exactly the n=3 aggregate sign boundary; signs valid for theta>0. The proof and finite exact arithmetic are sound, but originality is refuted by published equivalent full result.
